records.sourceAnchor: Cooperative eligibility, dairy and supporting activity scope, 5-8 year credit linkage, 1-3 year moratorium, funding routes, current application handoff and corpus-versus-entitlement boundary
observations: Dairy Sahakar is a cooperative dairy-business finance framework, not a universal grant or automatic subsidy. An applicant must be a cooperative society registered under a State or Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act with suitable bye-law provisions; the brochure also describes cooperative FPO/SHG eligibility subject to the applicable wording and guidelines.

Eligible activity groups cover bovine development, procurement, processing, quality assurance, value addition, branding, packaging, marketing, transport, storage, dairy exports and supporting activities including renewable energy, ICT, cattle feed, research, packaging materials, equipment, veterinary services, education and capacity development.

The official NCDC material states that project assistance has no fixed minimum or maximum for eligible cooperative projects, but sanction remains subject to viability, assessment, current NCDC terms, security and applicable permissions. This must not be displayed as an assured amount.

The NCDC compendium records a 5-8 year loan period including a 1-3 year principal moratorium. Interest is notified by NCDC from time to time. Security is required to NCDC satisfaction, and working-capital or margin-money assistance remains assessment-dependent.

Infrastructure funding patterns are route-specific: the compendium records up to 90% NCDC-to-State assistance with minimum 10% society share through the State route, and up to 70% direct NCDC assistance with minimum 30% society share. Margin money and working capital are separate benefit buckets.

The 2021 launch notice mentions a Rs 5,000 crore investment earmark for dairy cooperatives. It is scheme-level launch context, not a per-applicant ceiling, grant pool balance or guaranteed allocation.

The current NCDC dairy page and common loan application route confirm that the operational handoff is activity/purpose and loan-type specific. UdyamVeda may prepare the cooperative, project, permission, contribution and security checklist, but cannot submit the NCDC application, guarantee sanction or treat convergence as approved.
